name: liquid-metal
summary: Full-bleed hero running Paper Shaders' liquid metal on WebGL2: a soft chrome shard folding through itself on black, off-centre so the copy sits beside it, over a matched CSS shard.

colors.description: Ground then metal tint. Omit to read --fx-c1 and --fx-c2 off the section, which is what keeps the shader and the CSS resting state on one pair. Upstream noir preset.

speed.description: Rate the sheen travels. 0 renders a single static frame. Forced to 0 under prefers-reduced-motion.

repetition.description: How many bands the sheen folds into; high turns the sheet into stripes.

softness.description: Blur on the band edges. Low is polished chrome, high is brushed; the noir preset sits in between.

deviations.why: defaultPreset is a white-and-chrome sheet with the chromatic edge shift turned up: white, near-black and saturated red/cyan fringes all in one frame, which no ink colour clears 4.5:1 against. noirPreset is upstream's own soft dark variant -- #000000 ground, #606060 tint, softness 0.45, no shift, no distortion -- so the values are still upstream's, just the preset a hero can carry copy over.

deviations.what: u_offsetX is 0.3; every upstream liquid-metal preset uses 0.
deviations.why: The shader draws one object, and at offset 0 it sits dead centre, under the headline. 0.3 moves it right (measured: negative moves left) so the copy column has the left half of the section to itself. Nothing else about the shape changes.

deviations.what: No image is passed, so u_isImage is false and the shader draws its own shape.
deviations.why: The shader plates an image when given one. A generated site has to be self-contained, so paw-fx takes the no-image branch upstream already ships rather than fetching a mask. Nothing on that branch reads the sampler.
